CREATE TABLE entry_template_metric_value ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, template_metric_id BIGINT NOT NULL, unit_id BIGINT NOT NULL, value NUMERIC(19,5) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uk_entry_template_metric_value_unique_unit UNIQUE (template_metric_id, unit_id), CONSTRAINT fk_entry_template_metric_value_metric FOREIGN KEY (template_metric_id) REFERENCES entry_template_metric (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_entry_template_metric_value_unit FOREIGN KEY (unit_id) REFERENCES dictionary_item (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT );
CREATE INDEX idx_entry_template_metric_value_metric ON entry_template_metric_value (template_metric_id); CREATE INDEX idx_entry_template_metric_value_unit ON entry_template_metric_value (unit_id);
